## What was created

`tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVParserAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 3.8 test class (`extends junit.framework.TestCase`, no external helpers), in package `org.apache.commons.csv` so it can also exercise the package-private `nextRecord()`.

### Coverage (all expectations traced to `api/.../CSVParser.html` + the package summary)

| Area | Tests |
|---|---|
| **Constructors** | null-reader / null-format → `IllegalArgumentException` (2-arg and 4-arg); usable parser produced; 4-arg `recordNumber` seeds the number assigned to the first/next records ("next record number to assign") |
| **Static factories** | `parse` for String / Reader / File / Path / InputStream / URL — positive parse + documented null-argument `IllegalArgumentException`; `CSVFormat.parse(Reader)` shortcut; predefined `EXCEL` / `RFC4180` |
| **`getRecords()`** | returns every record with correct values; may be empty; starts at current parse position (after one `iterator().next()`); second call yields empty list; does not close the parser; `IOException` on a parse error (unterminated quote) |
| **Value parsing** | default & configurable delimiter; quoted value containing delimiter; doubled-quote escaping; multi-line quoted value; unequal record sizes; `\r` / `\n` / `\r\n` all terminate records on input |
| **Empty lines** | skipped by default; preserved as a size-1 empty-value record when `withIgnoreEmptyLines(false)` |
| **Comments** | comment lines removed; comment text exposed via `getComment()`/`hasComment()`; `#` is data when no marker set |
| **Surrounding spaces** | trimmed / preserved per `withIgnoreSurroundingSpaces` |
| **`getHeaderMap()`** | 0-based indices, column-order iteration, defensive copy (mutation doesn't leak), `null` when no header, `withSkipHeaderRecord` drops first row |
| **Counters** | `getRecordNumber()` 0 → 1 → 2 → 3; `getCurrentLineNumber()` starts at 0, counts EOLs, and runs ahead of record number for multi-line values (the ATTENTION note) |
| **`getFirstEndOfLine()`** | `\r\n`, `\n`, `\r`, and `null` when none encountered |
| **`close()` / `isClosed()`** | state flips on close; idempotent |
| **`iterator()`** | full traversal then `NoSuchElementException`; `next()` after close → `NoSuchElementException` (documented); `remove()` → `UnsupportedOperationException`; parse error re-thrown as `IllegalStateException` (documented); for-each iteration |
| **`nextRecord()`** | returns `null` at EOF and stays null; assigns increasing record numbers |
